# T-015: The program library: data, checks and the coach's review sheet

## Goal
Turn the research library (`library/source-UNREVIEWED.json`, seven 8-week programs) into data the
app can use, with checks that catch the known problems, a review state per program, and a readable
sheet for the coach who reviews them. No screen in this ticket (T-016 adds them).
Background: `docs/emails-gym-planning/REPO_AUDIT.md`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MASTER_PLAN.md` §4,
`research/EMAILS_GYM_PROGRAM_AUDIT.md` (P0/P1 issues).

### Inputs (already in the repo, do not edit except as stated)
- `library/source-UNREVIEWED.json`: the source. Never edited; corrections go in the converter or
  in `library/corrections.json` (new, may start empty), each with a reason.
- `library/exercise-map.json`: library exercise id → catalogue id (`catalogue/exercises/<id>.json`),
  plus a default catalogue exercise per cardio modality.
- `library/review.json`: per program `{ version, status, reviewer, date, notes }`;
  status `draft | needs_review | approved | retired`.

### What to build
1. **Pure helpers in `frontend/src/lib/library.js`** (+ `library.test.js`), framework-free:
   - `convertProgram(source, exerciseMap, corrections)` → the app's shape (below).
   - `validateProgram(p, catalogueIds)` → `{ errors: [], blockers: [] }`.
     Errors (structural): unknown exercise, sets < 1, rep min > max, RIR outside 0 to 5, seconds or
     minutes ≤ 0, week count ≠ weeks, sessions per week ≠ days per week, a session with nothing in it.
     Blockers (content, need the coach): interval cardio whose notes don't add up to its minutes
     (P0.1: parse "N min warm-up + K × (a min hard + b min easy) + c min cool-down" when present;
     unparseable interval notes are a blocker too), an estimated session time more than 10 minutes
     over the program's stated time (P1.6, estimate below), an exercise with no catalogue mapping.
   - `estimateMinutes(session)`: 8 min warm-up + per work set (40 s for reps, the hold's seconds for
     a timed set) + rest after every set but the last of each exercise, + cardio minutes. Rounded up
     to 5. Shown as a range per program (shortest to longest session), never one figure (P1.1).
   - `isVisible(program, review)`: every program is shown to everyone except `retired` ones (Emil's
     call, 2026-11-10: friends use them while the coach reviews). `reviewed(program, review)` says
     whether it is approved, for the badge.
   - `canApprove(program, reviewEntry)`: reviewer, date, `version` equal to the program's version,
     and no blockers. The build fails if `review.json` marks something approved that can't be.
2. **App shape** (plain JS, documented in a comment at the top of `library.js`):
   ```
   Program = { id, version, title, goal, level, days, weeks, minutes: [lo, hi], equipment: [catalogue
     equipment strings, from the mapped exercises], approach, notes, source: 'research-2026-11',
     templates: [Template], plan: [Week] }
   Template = { id, name, day, warmUp, items: [Item] }
   Item = { ex: catalogueId, mode: 'reps', sets, reps: [lo, hi], rir, rest, side?, note? }
        | { ex, mode: 'time', sets, sec: [lo, hi], rest, side?, note? }      (plank and other holds)
        | { ex, mode: 'cardio', min, intensity: 'easy' | 'interval', note? }
   Week = { week, note, items: { [templateId]: [{ sets, rir }] (same order as the template's items),
            cardio: { [templateId]: [min] } }
   ```
   `goal` keys: `muscle`, `strength`, `general`, `hybrid`, `endurance`, `efficient` (map the source's
   strings explicitly, test the map). `level`: `beginner`, `intermediate`, `any` (efficient-3's "all
   levels with exercise familiarity"), and conditioning-3's "beginner to intermediate" as
   `['beginner','intermediate']`; make `level` always an array. Plank's `reps` range becomes `sec`
   (P0.2). `side: true` from the source exercise's `unilateral`. Week sets/RIR come from
   `expanded_weeks` (already resolved there), not recomputed.
3. **`scripts/library/build.mjs`**: reads the inputs and the catalogue, converts, validates, writes
   `frontend/src/lib/library-data.js` (generated, header "generated by scripts/library/build.mjs, do
   not edit", like `exercises-data.js`) containing only programs, their review status and blockers.
   `--check` fails when the file is out of date or there are errors. `--review` writes
   `docs/emails-gym-planning/COACH_REVIEW.md` (below). Add `node scripts/library/build.mjs --check`
   to `scripts/fork/check.sh`.
4. **`COACH_REVIEW.md`** (generated, plain English, for a certified coach, printable): an intro
   (what the app does with these programs, that friends already use them and show "Not reviewed by
   a coach yet" until approved, and what approved changes); then per program: title, goal, level, days, stated and estimated minutes,
   equipment, approach; each session as a table (exercise name from the catalogue, sets × reps or
   seconds, RIR, rest, notes); the 8 weeks as a table of what changes (sets and RIR per week,
   cardio minutes); the blockers and warnings found; the exercise mapping used (library name →
   catalogue name) so the coach can confirm the choice; and a sign-off block (Approved / Approved
   with changes / Not approved, changes, name, date).

## Allowed files
- frontend/src/lib/library.js
- frontend/src/lib/library.test.js
- frontend/src/lib/library-data.js
- scripts/library/**
- scripts/fork/check.sh
- library/corrections.json
- docs/emails-gym-planning/COACH_REVIEW.md

## Forbidden files
Everything else, including `library/source-UNREVIEWED.json`, `library/exercise-map.json`,
`library/review.json` and anything under `catalogue/`.

## Rules
Follow AGENTS.md. No new dependencies. Never touch exercise media.

## Acceptance
- sh scripts/fork/check.sh

## Report
- The blockers found per program (expect hybrid-4 and conditioning-3 intervals).
- Estimated minute ranges per program next to the stated minutes.
- The tests you added. The check results.

## Out of scope
Screens, matching, starting a program, editing the source content.
